svg.title: Capacity chart – machines needed
svg.text: Capacity at the design point – 120 screws + 120 nuts + 200 rails + 400 blocks per day, 2 shifts × 7.5 h = 900 min, OEE 0.75 (heat treatment 3 shifts)
machines needed = Σ (cycle + set-up / batch) × start quantity / (available min × OEE); bar = utilisation of the n installed machines = need / n
EXAMPLE – check the machine maker's data
